LightningComponentBundle.description: Customizable nav button for LWR pages.

property.name: iconName
property.label: Icon Name
property.description: The Lightning Design System name of the icon. Names are written in the format 'utility:down' where 'utility' is the category, and 'down' is the specific icon to be displayed. If left blank, icon will not be displayed.

property.name: iconPosition
property.label: Icon Position
property.description: Describes the position of the icon with respect to the button label. Options include left and right. This value defaults to left.
